title: Checker command on gate define implies automated mode
description:
Defining a gate with a checker command but without an explicit mode silently produces a manual gate whose checker is never executed; a subsequent evaluate reports a pass without running anything. Hit live while exercising the structured-findings contract with a stub checker.

## Background

The mode flag defaults to manual, and the checker-command flag does not influence it. The failure is silent twice over: define succeeds, and evaluate on the manual gate reports success with no run record.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Defining a gate with a checker command and no explicit mode yields an automated gate.
- [hard] REQ-02: An explicit manual mode combined with a checker command is a usage error (exit 2) naming the conflict.
- [hard] REQ-03: Evaluating a manual gate does not report a pass without a recorded run; it fails with a hint naming the manual pass command.
- [hard] REQ-04: Behavior documented in the gate reference and help text.
